reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage preserves the allowed record identifiers and maps exact need text to capabilities. The resulting coverage correctly marks n06-r01 and n06-r07 unsupported and marks the six exact capability matches direct, so no localized fault is visible in this boundary.

prioritize_needs reverses the unsupported flag by setting unsupported true when coverage is direct. This behaviorally significant fault ranks covered needs before genuinely unsupported needs, contradicting the declared role to rank unsupported needs first and causing the top priority to become n06-r02 instead of the uncovered n06-r01.

synthesize_recommendation retains the eight-item window and derives the recommendation from the already-ranked first priority as declared. The bad recommendation is downstream of the malformed priorities produced by bnd-ec8195a15cc684b4, so this boundary is not the localized fault.
